minutes.headline: Finance Committee unanimously recommended the FY19 omnibus budget; held its view on old primary demolition debt exclusion.
minutes.summary: At the public hearing on the annual Town Meeting warrant, the town manager recapped the FY19 budget. Residents pressed for an added paramedic-level firefighter and for firmer demolition cost estimates for the old primary school. The committee voted recommendations on most budget articles and held others for Town Meeting presentations.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted unanimously to recommend the FY19 omnibus budget for Town Meeting.
The committee held its recommendation on the old primary school demolition debt exclusion until Town Meeting.
It also unanimously recommended the FY19 capital plan and the revolving fund bylaw article and limits.
A stabilization transfer from free cash and the FY19 sewer enterprise budget were recommended on votes that were not recorded as unanimous.
The PEG access budget recommendation was passed over until Town Meeting, pending a cable contract.

why_it_matters: The omnibus budget sets most of the town's spending for FY19, and residents will be asked to vote on it at Town Meeting.

The old primary demolition would be paid by a debt exclusion, which adds borrowing costs to property tax bills above the usual limit, so the open recommendation and cost estimates bear on a ballot vote.
watch_next: Town Meeting, where the committee's held recommendations on the old primary demolition debt exclusion and PEG access budget are due.
The ballot question on the Board of Selectmen agenda for April 3.
